name: PR86 joined Ashina native owner and property calibration; original admission unchanged

condition.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return p and p:IsTurnActive()

steps.code: local row=assert(GameInfo.JAC_LeaderPersonas['LEADER_JAC_ASHINA_MORIKIYO']); local d=assert(GameInfo.Governors[row.GovernorType]); assert(d.Index==4 and row.EvolutionCost==1); assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_TEST853_ADMISSION_RECEIPT')==nil); local n=0; for _,id in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajorIDs()) do for persona in GameInfo.JAC_LeaderPersonas() do local g=assert(GameInfo.Governors[persona.GovernorType]); assert(Players[id]:GetGovernors():CanEverAppointGovernor(g.Hash)==false); n=n+1 end end; assert(n==484); return 'unjoined 484 native pairs closed; Ashina runtime Index 4'

condition.code: local r=Game:GetProperty('JAC_TEST853_ADMISSION_RECEIPT'); return r and r.phase=='CLOSED' and r.pairs==484 and Players[0]:GetProperty(853304)==false and Players[1]:GetProperty(853304)==false

steps.code: local d=assert(GameInfo.Governors[GameInfo.JAC_LeaderPersonas['LEADER_JAC_ASHINA_MORIKIYO'].GovernorType]); assert(Players[0]:GetGovernors():CanEverAppointGovernor(d.Hash)==false and Players[1]:GetGovernors():CanEverAppointGovernor(d.Hash)==false); assert(Players[0]:GetProperty(853304)==false and Players[1]:GetProperty(853304)==false); return 'before join original native false for human 0 and AI 1'
assert(Players[0]:GetProperty(853304)==false and Players[1]:GetProperty(853304)==false); return 'before join UI cache has false derived Ashina key for both owners'
UI.RequestPlayerOperation(0,PlayerOperations.EXECUTE_SCRIPT,{OnStart='JAC_JoinedAdmissionPrepare'}); return 'request real Join, unique Great Person, official title and reservation'

condition.code: local r=Game:GetProperty('JAC_TEST853_ADMISSION_RECEIPT'); return r and r.phase=='EVOLVING' and r.owner==0 and r.source==2 and r.personCount==1 and r.total-r.spent>=1 and Players[0]:GetProperty(853304)==true and Players[1]:GetProperty(853304)==false

steps.code: local l='LEADER_JAC_ASHINA_MORIKIYO'; local r=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_TEST853_ADMISSION_RECEIPT')); assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_PERSONA_'..l..'_OWNER')==0 and Game:GetProperty('JAC_PERSONA_'..l..'_STATE')=='EVOLVING'); assert(Players[0]:GetGovernors():GetGovernorPointsSpent()==r.spent); assert(Players[0]:GetProperty(r.key)==true and Players[1]:GetProperty(r.key)==false); local d=GameInfo.Governors[GameInfo.JAC_LeaderPersonas[l].GovernorType]; assert(Players[0]:GetGovernors():CanEverAppointGovernor(d.Hash)==false); return 'authoritative reserve and UI true, static native qualification still false'

local d=assert(GameInfo.Governors[GameInfo.JAC_LeaderPersonas['LEADER_JAC_ASHINA_MORIKIYO'].GovernorType]); assert(Players[0]:GetGovernors():CanEverAppointGovernor(d.Hash)==false and Players[1]:GetGovernors():CanEverAppointGovernor(d.Hash)==false); assert(Players[0]:GetProperty(853304)==true and Players[1]:GetProperty(853304)==false); return 'after real reserve original native false for both; owner-only derived property true'
